name: Mismatched SourceArn and SourceAccount (suite-2 test 53)
note: IAM-1203 / suite-2 test 53: an S3 bucket policy grants cloudtrail.amazonaws.com s3:PutObject constrained by StringEquals aws:SourceAccount 111122223333 AND ArnLike aws:SourceArn arn:aws:cloudtrail:*:444455556666:trail/*. The two disagree - SourceAccount pins 111122223333 while the account component of SourceArn is 444455556666. AWS ANDs distinct condition keys, so the intended confused-deputy binding is internally inconsistent and likely ineffective. RESOURCE-CONFUSED-DEPUTY fires with the mismatch warning (medium); it must NOT be praised as source-bound and must NOT become a public-write finding. S3 object ARN carries no account, and the service principal is not '*', so PUBLIC-ACCESS / RESOURCE-CROSS-ACCOUNT do not fire.
